title: Infinite drag-and-wheel plane of project links
summary: A fixed pool of 24 DOM links on a `6 × 4` sheet, each moved by `translate3d` only to `mod(c·pitch + x0 + offset + pitch, span) − pitch` on both axes, the pitch held at `≥ stage / (count − 1)` so the wrap never opens a hole and odd columns staggered half a row; drag after a `6 px` threshold with pointer capture, release velocity from the last `100 ms` of samples (`0` after a `60 ms` rest, clamp `4000 px/s`), coasting by the exact integral of `v·e^(−4t)` on the shared ticker so a flick travels `v0 / 4` at any frame rate; wheel in both axes eased at `k = 16`, held back to the page until the stage is wholly in view; arrow keys move focus to the neighbour and the plane exactly one pitch (`.42 s` expo-out glide), Home / End centre the first / last project the short way round; the stage is an `overflow: hidden` scroll container parked one pitch in, so Tab, find-in-page and a screen reader's reveal scroll it instead of the page and the script turns that scroll into a glide `32 px` inside; `touch-action: none` on the stage only; no inertia and instant moves under reduced motion, a plain wrapped grid of the same links in the static tier
variants: DOM pool on a staggered 6 × 4 sheet, links in DOM order, shared-ticker inertia (this, default)
Plain sheet: STAGGER 0 for a straight grid; arrows then move one pitch on one axis only
GL planes: keep this pool, offset and key model as the DOM mirror and map each li's box to a plane, as in gl-dom-tethered-planes
